# Open Source Avatars

Registry: https://github.com/ToxSam/open-source-avatars

Pinned revision: 0f9a1b2fd99894736563d55b2c9dc9125700d081

Metadata is CC0. Individual avatar licenses are retained per collection in the generated catalog. Creator, license and source are displayed in Avatar studio. Models are downloaded directly from the registry URLs, not bundled or relicensed under AGPL.

Refresh with `node scripts/import-avatar-registry.mjs /path/to/registry-checkout`. Review license changes and run tests before shipping the updated catalog and server together.
